name: diamond_share_multiple.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (e Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (aVal Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (bVal Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (aVal Int)(bVal Int)(cVal Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((D (mk-D (aVal Int)(bVal Int)(dVal Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((E (mk-E (aVal Int)(bVal Int)(cVal Int)(dVal Int)(eVal Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  (lift-D (sel-D D))
  (lift-E (sel-E E))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-D ((this Ref)) D
  (sel-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-E ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-E (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-E ((this Ref)) E
  (sel-E (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
    (deref-is-E this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
    (deref-is-E this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-E this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-D this)
    (deref-is-E this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-E ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-E this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.e: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!e ((this Ref)) Ref
  (e (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class E:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for E.aVal: ---

(define-fun E.aVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (aVal (deref-E this))
)

; --- getters for E.bVal: ---

(define-fun E.bVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (bVal (deref-E this))
)

; --- getters for E.cVal: ---

(define-fun E.cVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (cVal (deref-E this))
)

; --- getters for E.dVal: ---

(define-fun E.dVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (dVal (deref-E this))
)

; --- getters for E.eVal: ---

(define-fun E.eVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (eVal (deref-E this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-E (TopLevelDeclarations!e this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (E.aVal (TopLevelDeclarations!e this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (E.bVal (TopLevelDeclarations!e this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (E.cVal (TopLevelDeclarations!e this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (E.dVal (TopLevelDeclarations!e this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (E.eVal (TopLevelDeclarations!e this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-A A)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-B B)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-C C)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class D:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-D D)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class E:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-E E)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        2 (lift-A const-2-A))
        3 (lift-B const-3-B))
        4 (lift-C const-4-C))
        5 (lift-D const-5-D))
        1 (lift-E const-1-E))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-B () B
  (mk-B 12))
(define-fun const-2-A () A
  (mk-A 13))
(define-fun const-5-D () D
  (mk-D 6 7 8))
(define-fun const-4-C () C
  (mk-C 9 10 11))
(define-fun const-1-E () E
  (mk-E 7720 21239 2438 8856 11798))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (e (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (bVal (sel-E a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (e (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (eVal (sel-E a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (e (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-E a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (e (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (cVal (sel-E a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (e (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (aVal (sel-E a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (e (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (dVal (sel-E a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
                  2
                  (lift-A (mk-A 13)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 3 (lift-B (mk-B 12))) 4 (lift-C (mk-C 9 10 11)))))
  (store (store a!2 5 (lift-D (mk-D 6 7 8)))
         1
         (lift-E (mk-E 7720 21239 2438 8856 11798))))))
